definition: First public release of the language, not the beginning of its development.
release_note: Martin Odersky dates the first Scala release to January 20, 2004.

primary_sources.title: 10 Years of Scala
primary_sources.finding: The official retrospective published January 22, 2014 dates the first release ten years earlier to January 20.

review_method: Official primary project pages read with the web service.
